parts.text:
Read draft.txt, verify Saturday, 10 a.m., 'bring a broken lamp', and 'repairs are free'. Give your actual review in one short paragraph; do not modify files.
Previous completed handoff: I edited `draft.txt` to revise the opening sentence from:

> "Join us at the Oakridge Public Library this Saturday at 10 a.m. for our community Repair Cafe."

to:

> "We warmly welcome you to the Oakridge Public Library this Saturday at 10 a.m. for our community Repair Cafe, where repairs are free."

This makes the opening more welcoming, incorporates the exact phrase "repairs are free", and preserves "Saturday", "10 a.m.", and the later phrase "bring a broken lamp".
You are the reviewer in a bounded writing workflow. Follow the user's exact file and role instructions. Be concise.
